evals.name: claim-as-wide-as-its-evidence
evals.expected_output: Each claim is scoped to the branch that makes it true: an env value is stripped, a file value is not; a missing env var falls through to the next source while a missing file key raises; and the caller list includes jobs/runner.py, found by following calls rather than imports, with the note that it rewrites and splits its sources before load sees them.
expectations: Says stripping applies only to environment values, not file values
Distinguishes the env fall-through from the file branch raising or returning without trying later sources
Lists jobs/runner.py as a caller even though it does not import settings
Notes that runner.py expands $HOME and splits on commas before calling load
Cites the line or branch behind each claim, or says which claims are unprobed
